summaries.title: DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents to Becoming Data Science Experts?
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「长程上下文建模与远距历史记忆衰减」痛点，作者围绕 **DSBench** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)），并引入 Relative Performance Gap (RPG) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To bridge this gap, we introduce DSBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate data science agents with realistic tasks。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：However, existing data science benchmarks still fall short when compared to real-world data science applications due to their simplified settings。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **34.12%, 34.74%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs, LVLMs, and agents shows that they struggle with most tasks, with the best agent solving only 34.12% of data analysis tasks and achieving a...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 66 赞），本工作可作为评估 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Source2Synth: Synthetic Data Generation and Curation Grounded in Real Data Sources
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」痛点，作者围绕 **Source2Synth** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、合成数据（Synthetic Data）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we propose Source2Synth: a new method that can be used for teaching LLMs new skills without relying on costly human annotations。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Source2Synth takes as input a custom data source and produces synthetic data points with intermediate reasoning steps grounded in real-world sources。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **25.51%, 22.57%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our method improves performance by 25.51% for TQA on WikiSQL and 22.57% for MHQA on HotPotQA compared to the fine-tuned baselines）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 21 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)** 中的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
